messages:
Amanda L.: Quick experiment proposal — combine a small free-credits grant ($25 equiv) + a short beginner webinar + in-app prompt templates as an onboarding nudge. Two cohorts: A = credits + templates, B = credits + webinar invite. Primary metric: % who generate within 48h. Secondary: 7d retention and 30d conversion. Thoughts? :rocket:

Raj P.: Love it. What's the audience? New signups last 7 days? Or trial users with no activity?

Amanda L.: New signups (last 7d), <= 10 API calls. Target n=8k split 60/40. Randomize at signup via feature flag. Templates will be surfaced in-app and in the welcome email.

Jordan (Growth): Can we route webinar RSVPs as MQLs to the inbound queue? Prefer auto-assign to SDR for enterprise domains.

Sophia - PMM: I can draft the webinar landing + email copy. Suggested email subjects to A/B: "Get started faster with Redwood — free credits + templates" or "Ship your first LLM feature in 30 minutes". Also will create 3 starter prompt templates.

Luis - Data: Metrics to track: activation (generate within 48h), 7d DAU, conversion to paid (30d), RSVP rate, attendance rate, post-webinar activation uplift. I'll add cohort ids and make sure UTMs are consistent.

Amanda L.: Campaign params: utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=onboard-nudge-mar26, template_shown boolean, credit_amount=25. Snippet for feature flag payload to engineers: ```json
{"experiment":"onboard_nudge_mar26","cohort":"A","credit_amount":25}
```

campaign-bot: Reminder scheduled — landing page goes live Tue 2026-03-31 10:00 PDT. Automations: send webinar invite 48h after signup for cohort B.

Jordan (Growth): Quick operational check — do we double-credit users who already have promo credits? Need rule to prevent stacking.

Amanda L.: Good catch. Rule: only apply if total_credits == 0. I'll add to rollout checklist and config.

Raj P.: For routing: inbound leads who RSVP + attend -> tag 'webinar-engaged' and push to Salesforce as Lead.Owner = SDR pool; RSVP without attendance -> nurture path. Anyone object?

Sophia - PMM: No objections. I'll prepare templates named 'support-summarizer', 'feature-brainstorm', 'code-assistant-starter' with 1-line usage tips.

Luis - Data: I'll build a Metabase dashboard and backfill baseline numbers. Baseline activation ~12%, target uplift to 22% for templates cohort. Will add conversion events and cohort dims.

Amanda L.: Timeline: landing + email copy by Mon EOD, tracking + cohort ids Tue AM, rollout Wed. Jordan — can you create the webinar event and RSVP form?

Jordan (Growth): On it. I'll post calendar + RSVP link here by EOD.

Amanda L.: Next steps (owners + due dates):
- Sophia - copy + templates (Mon EOD)
- Luis - dashboard + cohort ids (Tue AM)
- Jordan - webinar + RSVP (EOD today)
- Raj - routing rules + SFDC mapping (Tue)
We'll do a quick sync Friday for go/no-go. Thanks team! :sparkles:
